statement: For the actual arithmetic G3 source, the complete moving cusp-fixed conjugator-pair space, its restriction to Hom_G(V,W), its exact local and transgression maps, and its full kernel are proved. Its homology image dimension d is at least 80*3^95-4*3^45-4*3^34>0. The actual Q=576 marked graph certifies the exact G3 centralizer and Jordan data used in this bound. The integral cusp map is onto and its kernel reduces onto the full modulo-two parameter space. Doubled integral pairs give actual peripheral automorphisms of the complete D50 source preserving the entire D49 action and parameter; their differences have an elementary abelian quotient of dimension d detected on homology modulo four. Separately, for the literal order-1080 source, all 102 same-action conjugator ambiguities are evaluated. Their invariant-obstruction image has rank four and repairs the earlier pairing-preserving rank-16 homology action without changing any modulo-two homology column. Its full 4,220,100-letter cusp word and generation are checked in the unquotiented class-two target.
